canonical_statement: For every real epsilon with 0 < epsilon < 1 and every natural r at least two, there is a positive n0 such that for every n > n0, every n-vertex finite simple graph with fewer than (1/(2(r-1)) - epsilon)n^2 edges has r mutually disjoint groups, each of some positive natural size k at least sqrt(l_(r-1)(n)), with no edges between distinct groups.

source_selection.citation: P. Erdos and A. H. Stone, On the structure of linear graphs, Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society 52 (1946), 1087-1091, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9904-1946-08715-7
source_selection.relationship_to_catalog: The catalog gives only the theorem name and 1946 attribution. This phase selects the uniquely named theorem in the attributed paper, rather than silently substituting the later fixed-forbidden-graph density corollary or a minimum-degree strengthening.
source_selection.review_boundary: The page image and definitions fix the displayed proposition. Complete correction and errata review, proof-node mapping, modern-equivalence transport, and independent H0 approval remain open.

domain_and_universes: Closed Prop in universe 0: epsilon : Real; r n0 n : Nat; G : SimpleGraph (Fin n); a local DecidableRel G.Adj instance; natural iteration and part size; real edge-count comparison.
hypotheses: the real cast of G.edgeFinset.card is strictly less than (1/(2*(r-1)) - epsilon) * n^2
conclusion: There exists a positive k : Nat with sqrt(iteratedLog (r-1) n) <= k such that completeEquipartiteGraph r k is contained in the complement of G; this gives r disjoint equal-sized groups and every cross-group pair is a nonedge of G.

encoding_decisions.finite_graph: SimpleGraph (Fin n), matching an n-vertex finite loopless simple graph with labeled vertices
encoding_decisions.iterated_log: iteratedLog j x = Real.log^[j] x, matching l_1(x)=ln(x) and l_j(x)=ln(l_(j-1)(x))
encoding_decisions.part_size: an existential natural k with the explicit conjunct 0 < k and sqrt(l_(r-1)(n)) <= k, preserving the source's 'for some k' wording and its positive-integer convention
encoding_decisions.groups: containment of completeEquipartiteGraph r k in G complement; the copy is injective and hence the parts are disjoint, and adjacency in the complement means nonadjacency in G
encoding_decisions.threshold: explicit exists n0, 0 < n0 and forall n, n0 < n, preserving the source's positive-integer convention and strict n > n0
encoding_decisions.edge_bound: strict less-than after casting the finite edge count to Real, preserving 'fewer than'
encoding_decisions.boundary: epsilon endpoints zero and one and r below two are excluded. Values n at or below n0 are outside the conclusion. Eventual largeness handles positivity of the iterated logarithm; no separate domain restriction is invented.

minimal_import_evidence: The two narrow direct imports supply Real/log/sqrt/iteration and simple-graph complete-equipartite containment. Deleting either import makes the exact module fail. No Erdos-Stone proof-bearing module is imported.
